purpose: Rules correction of an explicit raw manifest. Offline reference is synthetic. The 149-segment CPU run is separate and is not an align pass.
input_identity: offline uses fixed synthetic rows; REAL_CHAIN_CORRECT_MODE=cpu149 reads REAL-ASR-001 repair-1 historical-batch run-1 legacy-format raw
allowed_variable: REAL_CHAIN_CORRECT_MODE=cpu149 runs the 149-segment rules path; unset or offline is the synthetic reference
failure_policy: stop at the first failed check; do not fall back to baseline B
cache_policy: python -B; no bytecode in the legacy repository

permissions.read: explicit raw and, for comparison only, baseline manifests

oracle: synthetic host output must match a direct run_correction_stage call; baseline B is a comparison, not an oracle
not_accepted: copying B transcript as this round's output
